info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Weather Alerts Severitys-v2-spec
info.description: The Weather Alerts Severity API provides users with real-time access to the severity levels of current weather alerts. This endpoint allows consumers, such as weather services and application developers, to retrieve a list of active alerts categorized by their severity. It enables businesses to better inform their users about impending weather conditions, fostering timely decision-making. Developers can utilize this information to enhance their applications with critical weather updates and improve user safety.

get.description: Fetch the list of available severity levels for alerts, providing insights into the importance of each alert type in the system. This resource helps users understand how to prioritize alerts based on their severity.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to specify the severity levels of alerts you want to retrieve. It allows clients to filter alerts based on their severity, ensuring that only relevant alerts are returned.

202.description: The request has been accepted and is being processed.

ListWeatherAlertsSeveritysRequest.description: A string representing the severity level of an alert.
